tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen (the palette base).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, chips, the question card. White on light themes; the palette secondary on Dark Mode Focus.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, headings, math and diagram strokes (the palette text color).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, crumbs, counters, placeholders. Derived from text + secondary; at least 4.5:1 on bg and card.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: The palette secondary: secondary-button borders, progress track accents, quiet UI.

tokens.name: secondary-soft
tokens.usage: Very light secondary fill for quiet surfaces.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The palette accent: primary buttons, shaded parts of fraction bars and grids, progress fill, active tab.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The accent darkened (or lightened on dark) until it reads as text: links, secondary-button labels, hero title. At least 4.5:1 on card.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: The pressed-edge shadow under primary buttons, and the end of the progress gradient.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft accent: secondary-button fill, input borders, diagram fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills (primary buttons, active tabs): white or the theme text, whichever reads at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fill inside a card: worked examples, solutions, answer choices, unearned badges.

tokens.name: tip
tokens.usage: Warm gold-tinted panel: hints, tips, earned badges, a mastered topic.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, dividers, dashed "add" borders, chart grid lines.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of an answer box before it is focused.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ink-colored surfaces (the level-up toast).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Correct: border of the right choice, praise text, first-try dot. Tuned to the palette; at least 3:1 on card.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the correct choice after checking.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Missed: wrong-choice border, missed dot, delete links. At least 3:1 on card.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of a wrongly picked choice; weak-topic rows in the parent report.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: "Try again" text, the height line in diagrams, the number-line marker. At least 3:1 on card.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Earned stars and the second-try dot.

tokens.name: star-off
tokens.usage: Stars not yet earned.

tokens.name: unit-fractions
tokens.usage: Unit color: fractions (tile edge, heading bar). Decorative only.

tokens.name: unit-decimals
tokens.usage: Unit color: decimals.

tokens.name: unit-naturals
tokens.usage: Unit color: operations with natural numbers.

tokens.name: unit-data
tokens.usage: Unit color: data and average.

tokens.name: unit-geometry
tokens.usage: Unit color: geometry and area.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: App name on the profile screen.

styles.name: answer
styles.usage: What the child types into an answer box.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: The question text above an exercise.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, crumbs, meta lines, table text.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles, choices and buttons.

tokens.name: space-stack
tokens.usage: Space between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Space above a unit or section heading.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Cards, topic tiles, profile cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, answer boxes, choices, badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Hints, examples, small panels, text fields.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tabs, the progress bar.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Lifted surfaces: cards, tiles, chips. A firm bottom edge plus a soft glow, so things look pressable. Deeper black on Dark Mode Focus.
